shared_elements: low relief carving on a stone surface
border or framing band along an edge
repeated small rosette-like or circular motifs
justification: Both are low-relief carvings that use a framing band with small repeated round motifs along an edge, which is the only reasonably specific correspondence, and it is a near-universal decorative device. A depicts a procession of naturalistic standing human figures in profile with distinctive headgear, hands touching and held objects, while B shows no human figures at all but dense abstract scroll and volute forms with blocky step-fret elements, so the subject matter and conventions of depiction are fundamentally different.
